# Ed Dolan's Econ Blog

> > Economic analysis and policy commentary covering macroeconomic indicators, fiscal policy, social safety nets, environmental economics, and trade from economist Ed Dolan

This blog provides data-driven economic analysis focusing on U.S. GDP trends, Federal Reserve policy, tax reform, healthcare, climate policy, and social programs like Social Security and universal basic income. Ed Dolan examines economic data from the Bureau of Economic Analysis and Bureau of Labor Statistics while offering policy critiques across administrations from Obama to Trump.

## Key Topics

- GDP analysis and measurement
- Federal Reserve monetary policy
- Social Security reform
- Universal Basic Income (UBI)
- Carbon tax and climate policy
- Trade policy and globalization
- Healthcare reform
- Tax policy and fiscal reform
- Labor markets and wage stagnation
- Economic recovery and business cycles
- Bureau of Economic Analysis data
- China-U.S. economic relations
- Energy policy
- Per capita economic measures

## Macroeconomic Analysis and GDP

- [The Coronavirus and the Economy: A Tutorial](https://dolanecon.blogspot.com/2020/03/the-coronavirus-and-economy-tutorial.html): COVID-19 macroeconomic tutorial on demand/supply shocks and recession
- [Investment and Exports Explain Why the economy Isn't Taking Off Like a Rocket](https://dolanecon.blogspot.com/2019/08/investment-and-exports-explain-why.html): Analysis of Trump-era GDP growth, tax cuts, and Federal Reserve policy
- [Total US GDP Grows 3.2 Percent in Q4. That's Nice, but Why do We Pay So Little Attention to Per Capita Measures?](https://dolanecon.blogspot.com/2014/02/total-us-gdp-grows-32-percent-in-q4.html): Q4 2013 GDP analysis advocating for per capita measurement focus
- [Latest US GDP Numbers Confirm Consumer-Led Expansion but Government and Exports were Weaker than Previously Thought](https://dolanecon.blogspot.com/2013/05/latest-us-gdp-numbers-confirm-consumer.html): Q1 2013 GDP revision showing consumer strength, weak government & exports
- [US GDP Barely Grows in Q4 2012; Recovery on Life Support](https://dolanecon.blogspot.com/2013/02/us-gdp-barely-grows-in-q4-2012-recovery.html): Q4 2012 GDP analysis examining sluggish recovery and consumption trends
- [U.S. Domestic Income Grows Strongly in Q4 2011, Outpacing Growth of GDP](https://dolanecon.blogspot.com/2012/03/us-domestic-income-grows-strongly-in-q4.html): Q4 2011 GDI growth analysis outpacing GDP from Bureau of Economic Analysis

## Social Safety Nets and Welfare Policy

- [Universal Basic Income vs. Unemployment Insurance: Which is the Better Safety Net?](https://dolanecon.blogspot.com/2014/11/universal-basic-income-vs-unemployment.html): Comparing UBI and unemployment insurance as social safety net policies
- [How Conservatives Could Design a Fair and Efficient Healthcare System if they Took their Time](https://dolanecon.blogspot.com/2017/07/how-conservatives-could-design-fair-and.html): Conservative healthcare reform proposal with universal catastrophic coverage
- [Is the Chained CPI the Right Fix for Social Security?](https://dolanecon.blogspot.com/2013/04/is-chained-cpi-right-fix-for-social.html): Evaluating Obama's chained CPI proposal for Social Security adjustments

## Trade, Globalization, and International Economics

- [In Search of the Elusive Victims of Globlization](https://dolanecon.blogspot.com/2017/02/in-search-of-elusive-victims-of.html): Examining globalization impacts and China shock amid 2016 election debates
- [Trump Blames US Export Woes on Chinese Currency Manipulation. Really?](https://dolanecon.blogspot.com/2015/07/trump-blames-us-export-woes-on-chinese.html): Fact-checking Trump's claims on Chinese currency manipulation and exports
- [How Flawed Leadership Selection Harms the Economies of China and the US](https://dolanecon.blogspot.com/2012/07/how-flawed-leadership-selection-harms.html): Comparing China-US political economy and leadership selection flaws

## Environmental and Energy Policy

- [Why California's Push for a 100 Percent Carbon Free Grid is the Wrong Way Forward](https://dolanecon.blogspot.com/2017/03/why-californias-push-for-100-percent.html): Critiquing California's carbon-free grid vs carbon pricing approaches
- [Parsing the Polls: Does US Public Opinion Realy Support a Strong Climate Policy?](https://dolanecon.blogspot.com/2015/12/parsing-polls-does-us-public-opinion.html): Analyzing US climate policy polling during COP21 Paris negotiations
- [Could America's New Energy Abundance Spark a Trans-Atlantic Environmental Race to the Bottom?](https://dolanecon.blogspot.com/2013/11/could-americas-new-energy-abundance.html): Energy abundance, carbon tax, and trans-Atlantic environmental policy race

## Labor Markets and Wages

- [Chart of the Day: How Badly have Real Wages Stagnated?](https://dolanecon.blogspot.com/2017/01/chart-of-day-how-badly-have-real-wages.html): Real wage stagnation analysis using CPI vs PCE inflation measures
- [Solving the Mystery of Keynes' "Mistaken" Prediction: Why Don't we Work Less and Take More Leisure](https://dolanecon.blogspot.com/2013/06/solving-mystery-of-keynes-mistaken.html): Examining Keynes' work-leisure prediction and productivity paradox
- [Looking for the Good News in the April Jobs Report](https://dolanecon.blogspot.com/2012/05/looking-for-good-news-in-april-jobs.html): April jobs report analysis from Bureau of Labor Statistics data

## Fiscal Policy and Tax Reform

- [Economists Should Love Paul Ryan's Support of Policy Rules—but are they the Right Rules?](https://dolanecon.blogspot.com/2012/08/economists-should-love-paul-ryans.html): Evaluating Paul Ryan's monetary and fiscal policy rules framework
- [Classroom Debate Topic: Should We Keep the Charitable Deduction or Scrap It?](https://dolanecon.blogspot.com/2012/12/classroom-debate-topic-should-we-keep.html): Educational debate on charitable tax deduction during fiscal cliff talks
